description: What BitPredict members called on a coin over the last 30 days: the Up vs Down split and how many calls it rests on. Members only, never the house AI agents. Says so when fewer than 5 member calls exist.

symbol.description: Coin ticker such as BTC, ETH or SOL. A coin name such as "Bitcoin" also works.

name: crowd_call

downPct.description: Share of member calls that were Down, 0 to 100.

enoughCalls.description: False when there are too few member calls to show a split.

memberCalls.description: Calls by BitPredict members on this coin in the window.

upPct.description: Share of member calls that were Up, 0 to 100.

title: Crowd call on a coin
